name: Saco Parks and Recreation Summer Camp
description_short: A city run day camp in Saco for children in rising grades K to 8, split into four age groups at the Community Center, Fairfield School and CK Burns School. Camp runs Monday to Friday, 7:30am to 5:30pm, with on camp activities, water play and field trips.
refund_policy_summary: Full summer: cancel by June 5, 2026 for a card refund or account credit. Weekly: cancel by 3pm the Thursday before. No credit for unused days or weeks, the enrollment fee is not refundable, and card refunds carry a 5% fee.
swim_waterfront_notes: The guide says all camps have water activities often and the Community Center group uses the splash pad. It does not describe swimming in a pool or lake.
notes: Prices shown are non-resident rates. Saco residents pay $250 a week or $1,700 for the full summer. Groups: Camp Chickadees (rising K to 1) and Camp Teen Trailblazers (rising 6 to 8) at the Community Center, Camp Pioneers (rising 2 to 3) at Fairfield School, Camp Black Bears (rising 4 to 5) at CK Burns School; from August 3 all groups meet at the Community Center.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 camp guide. Prices are non-resident rates; resident rates are in notes. Weekly dates are the 8 Monday to Friday weeks of the stated June 22 to August 14 season; the guide does not list each week. Grades are rising grades.
